info.title: Deep Work Plan Agent API
info.summary: Read-only, zero-auth agent surface for deepworkplan.com: LLM guidance files, per-page Markdown mirrors in 17 languages, machine-readable discovery documents, and a stateless MCP server.
info.description:
The Deep Work Plan (DWP) methodology site exposes a public, read-only, zero-auth surface built for AI agents. No API keys, no OAuth, no registration: every endpoint is anonymous GET except the MCP endpoint, which is POST.

**When to use this API:** fetch the canonical adoption prompt (`/init.md`) to make any repository AI-first with DWP; read any page as native source Markdown (`Accept: text/markdown` or explicit `.md` URLs) in 17 languages; discover the site map via `llms.txt`, the sitemap, or the ARD catalog; and drive the site programmatically through the MCP server at `/api/mcp` (tools: `get_init_prompt`, `list_site_sections`, `read_page`).

**When not to use it:** this is a documentation/marketing site — there are no write operations, user accounts, or telemetry endpoints. Do not look for them here.

Errors: unknown `/api/*` paths return a structured JSON error (`ApiError`), never HTML. Non-API paths return the HTML 404 page (or a Markdown recovery body when `Accept: text/markdown` is sent).

**Versioning and deprecation:** the agent API is URL-path versioned at `/api/v1/` (the versioned family: `index.json`, `sections.json`, `pages.json`, `health.json`). The unversioned canonical paths (`/api/mcp`, `/api/health.json`) are part of the v1 contract. Breaking changes ship only in a new `/api/v{N+1}/` family; a deprecated endpoint answers with `Deprecation` (RFC 9745) and `Sunset` (RFC 8594) headers at least 180 days before removal, plus a `Link; rel="deprecation"` header pointing at the migration target.

**Rate limits:** every `/api/*` response carries `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset`, and `RateLimit-Policy` (RFC 9331; policy `q=120; window=60; burst=0`). Enforcement is a best-effort per-isolate fixed-window limiter at the edge — not a global guarantee — and tripped callers receive `429` with a `Retry-After` header and an `ApiError` body.

post.description:
Model Context Protocol server for deepworkplan.com over JSON-RPC 2.0. Stateless (no session id, no SSE). Supported methods: `initialize`, `ping`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`. Notifications (no `id`) receive `202` with an empty body; batching is not supported.

Tools: `get_init_prompt` (canonical adoption prompt), `list_site_sections` (site map), `read_page` (any page as source Markdown).

Protocol versions: `2025-03-26`, `2025-06-18` (send the `MCP-Protocol-Version` header; when absent `2025-03-26` is assumed).

200.description: JSON-RPC response (success result or JSON-RPC error object for method-not-found / invalid-params).

MCP-Protocol-Version.description: Protocol version in effect for this request.

202.description: Accepted notification — empty body, no response object. This is a JSON-RPC 2.0 notification acknowledgment per the MCP Streamable HTTP transport spec, not a REST async-job pattern: it does not create a job, there is nothing to poll for, and no Location or job_id follows. Every other request on this endpoint (all tool calls) resolves synchronously in the same response.

400.description: Unparseable body, invalid JSON-RPC envelope, or unsupported MCP-Protocol-Version header.

error.message: Parse error: request body must be a single JSON-RPC 2.0 object.

405.description: Method not allowed (only POST and OPTIONS). Includes `Allow: POST, OPTIONS`.

415.description: Unsupported Media Type — Content-Type must be application/json.

429.description: Rate limit tripped (best-effort edge limiter). Back off for the announced window.

error.message: Too many requests to the agent API. Retry after the announced window.
error.hint: See RateLimit-Reset and Retry-After headers; the limit is advisory best-effort at the edge.

ApiError.description: Structured error body for /api/* paths — agents should never have to parse HTML errors.

hint.description: How to resolve or retry the request.

docs.description: Where to read more (usually the OpenAPI spec).

JsonRpcRequest.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 request object. `id` absent ⇒ notification (202, empty body). Batching (arrays) is not supported.

id.description: Caller-supplied identifier echoed in the response.

params.description: Method parameters. tools/call needs {name: string, arguments?: object}.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code: -32700 parse, -32600 invalid request, -32601 method not found, -32602 invalid params, -32603 internal.

JsonRpcResponse.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 response: either `result` or `error`, never both.

result.description: initialize: {protocolVersion, capabilities, serverInfo, instructions}; tools/list: {tools: […]}; tools/call: {content: [{type: 'text', text}], isError: boolean}; ping: {}.

Linkset.description: RFC 9727 linkset of the service documents.

rel.description: Link relation, e.g. service-doc, service-desc, describedby.

type.description: Media type of the referenced resource.

digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the referenced skill document.

spec_version.description: DWP standard version this repo conforms to.

OAuthAuthorizationServerMetadata.description: RFC 8414 stub — the site is zero-auth today; see /auth.md.

OAuthProtectedResourceMetadata.description: RFC 9728 stub — no OAuth-protected resources today; see /auth.md.

code.description: ISO language code; `en` is the default (unprefixed) language.

pages.description: Sorted page slugs (English slugs shared across languages).

PageJsonEnvelope.description: Typed JSON envelope for a page mirror, served when a client sends Accept: application/json (and does not also prefer text/html or text/markdown). Wraps the same page Markdown served at Accept: text/markdown — contentFormat records that the body is Markdown, not that it was converted.

url.description: Absolute URL of the requested page.

title.description: Page title, extracted from the first `# ` heading of the Markdown source (falls back to the request path when absent).

markdown.description: The page's original Markdown source, unmodified — the same body served at Accept: text/markdown.

language.description: Detected page language: the first path segment when it is one of the 17 active language codes, else `en`.

recovery.description: Absolute links to the site's machine-readable discovery surface.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current window (RFC 9331).

RateLimitReset.description: Seconds until the window resets (RFC 9331); 0 when tripped.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (RFC 9331 / RFC 7231). One full window.

Deprecation.description: RFC 9745 deprecation marker. Value is `true@<unix-timestamp>` when the endpoint was marked deprecated.

Sunset.description: RFC 8594 Sunset date (IMF-fixdate). Endpoint will be removed on or after this date.

Link.description: RFC 8288 Link header; when deprecation is active, includes rel="deprecation" pointing to migration guidance.
